title: Authenticate European Star Cross LZ streams
platforms: European ROM; retained Wine evidence and protected static source plan
changes: Authenticate two previously unowned type-10 compressed sources observed in the Star Cross continuation.
validation: Protected unit vx5hei60 decodes 4,960 source bytes to 9,296 bytes with exact consumption, verifies every source byte was sampled by the bus and excludes overlap with E292 owners.
limitations: Game-level asset identities, instruction PCs, all callers, runtime integration, real BIOS and DMA, other scenes, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance comparison was made.
